name: io.github.Cee62/cicash
description: Give an agent a bounded, revocable, auditable CIcash budget. It gets tools to check its balance, get signed quotes, pay, and sub-delegate - and no tool that can widen a budget.

environmentVariables.name: CICASH_WALLET
environmentVariables.description: Path to the wallet blob issued by `cicash grant`. This file is a credential.

environmentVariables.name: CICASH_DB
environmentVariables.description: SQLite ledger path. Omit for an in-memory ledger.
